turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: your tracking isn’t updating, here are the best next checks: - Review your tracking details on our tracking page and on the carrier’s website—larger orders often ship separately, so some items may still be in transit and can arrive within 1–2 business days. - Do a quick sweep around your home (front porch, side door, garage, carport), since carriers sometimes leave packages in discreet spots. - Check with your neighbours in case it was accepted for safekeeping or delivered next door by mistake.
